metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover near the Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth greater in 1984 than in 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Rosetta branch of the Nile mouth (approximately 31.5°N, 30.4°E in Egypt) - Date: 1984 (use Landsat 5) vs 2021 (use Landsat 8/9 or Sentinel-2) - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8/9 for 2021 - Use NDVI as the metric for vegetation cover 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we're measuring vegetation, not clouds - Use QA bands for cloud masking in both Landsat collections 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 - Check collection sizes first (C1) - Check pixel counts after masking (C2) - Compare mean NDVI values: if 1984 > 2021, answer A; else B - If result is None/NaN or outside valid range, answer C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry around Rosetta branch of Nile mouth const roiPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([30.4, 31.5]); const roi = roiPoint.buffer(5000); // 5km radius buffer // 2. Data Acquisition for 1984 (Landsat 5) let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1984 = await col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images found: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log("No data for 1984."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2021 (Landsat 8) let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2021 = await col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images found: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 as fallback col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2021_fallback = await col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images found (Landsat 9): ${size2021_fallback}`); if (size2021_fallback === 0) { console.log("No data for 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat Collection 2 function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } function maskL5sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } // 5. Calculate NDVI for both years function addNDVI(image) { const nir = image.select('SR_B4'); const red = image.select('SR_B3'); const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } function addNDVI_L8(image) { const nir = image.select('SR_B5'); const red = image.select('SR_B4'); const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const img1984 = col1984.map(maskL5sr).map(addNDVI).median(); const img2021 = col2021.map(maskL8sr).map(addNDVI_L8).median(); // 6. Check valid pixels const count1984 = await img1984.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2021 = await img2021.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Valid pixels: ${count1984}`); console.log(`2021 Valid pixels: ${count2021}`); if (count1984 === 0 || count2021 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Calculate mean NDVI const ndvi1984 = await img1984.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2021 = await img2021.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Mean NDVI: ${ndvi1984}`); console.log(`2021 Mean NDVI: ${ndvi2021}`); // 8. Validation & Final Answer if (ndvi1984 === null || ndvi2021 === null || isNaN(ndvi1984) || isNaN(ndvi2021)) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (ndvi1984 < -1 || ndvi1984 > 1 || ndvi2021 < -1 || ndvi2021 > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (ndvi1984 > ndvi2021) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
